summary: Backend-only validation of Phase 1 wallet-shortfall cash settlement chain (SB Drive). Existing iter249/iter249b suites kept as regression and all pass (4/4). Added iter250 covering the 3 gaps requested by E1: (A) cash payment_method ride leaves the whole fare as cash_due (no wallet debit); (B) collect-cash 403 guard against non-owner/non-admin; (C) wallet transfer to a debtor auto-settles outstanding ride_balance debt first. Full suite 7/7 passing against the public preview URL.

minor.issue: Cash rides land in payment_status='pending_cash' while the wallet-shortfall path uses 'cash_due'. Both work correctly with collect-cash, but the dual labels are inconsistent and undocumented — consider unifying to 'cash_due' for both.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Harmonize payment_status labels between cash rides ('pending_cash') and wallet-shortfall rides ('cash_due') — same downstream behavior, confusing for analytics/UI.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rides.py::collect_cash correctly enforces driver-owner OR admin (drv.id == ride.driver_id). The check uses db.drivers.find_one({user_id: user.id}) so a passenger / merchant / different driver all get 403 as verified.
routes/rides.py wallet settlement uses atomic $inc with {balance: {$gte: charge}} filter — good race protection; the fallback path sets cash_due=amt on race. Solid.
routes/wallet.py::transfer calls auto_settle_debts_from_wallet(to_user_id) AFTER crediting the receiver — verified with iter250 case C (7 € debt cleared, 3 € net credited).
routes/wallet.py::topup returns debt_recovered + balance net of recovery — verified by iter249b (full + partial).

Minor inconsistency: payment_status='pending_cash' for cash rides vs 'cash_due' for wallet shortfall. Collect-cash branches on cash_due_to_driver value only, so both work, but a unified label would simplify the UI filter.

collect_cash short-circuits when cash_due<=0 returning 200 + 'Aucun montant à percevoir' — fine but it does NOT enforce authorization in that early-return; low risk since nothing changes, but consider checking auth before the cash_due short-circuit for defense-in-depth.

seed_data_creation: All test fixtures are created and torn down within each test (ride documents prefixed ride_test_*, debt rows prefixed debt_test_*). Wallet balances are snapshotted and restored. No orphan rows left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 cash settlement is fully covered by 3 files (iter249, iter249b, iter250 = 7 tests). Run them with: TEST_API_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter249*.py /app/backend/tests/test_iter250_cash_due_full_chain.py -v. Tests rely on db.rides + db.cancellation_debts (reason=ride_balance) + db.wallets. SBPAYGO Connect module is feature-flagged off and intentionally skipped per request.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in the Phase 1 cash flow. All 7 scenarios (wallet shortfall → cash_due, Reçu → paid, Non reçu → debt with notification, full cash → cash_due, top-up recovery full+partial, transfer recovery, unauthorized collect-cash → 403) behave as specified.
